_comment: Dynamic 1-hour trace: Azure-shaped arrival rate (10-50 req/s, 4 peaks) with
a mix schedule A -> C -> B -> A. Both knobs live in the trace csv, which is
replayed by --mode trace-replay: the runner reads `arrival_s`, this workload
reads `class` from the SAME file, paired by row index. There is deliberately
no `mix` block -- with a class plan the per-arrival classes are already fixed,
and a second declaration here could silently disagree with the trace.
.plan.json holds the per-segment targets and realised ratios.
Pools are identical to mix_polyserve.json (EXP-21) on purpose. Replay is
byte-identical (`literal replay`), so after the first pass every prompt is a
prefix-cache hit either way; changing pool sizes would only break
comparability with EXP-14/17/21. Cycling over the hour: chat ~40x (1000
conversations), swe ~25x (1500 transcript calls), deepresearch none (60k).
The SLO block is what the client packs into the OpenAI 'priority' field as
ttft_ms*1000 + tbt_ms; tbt_ms doubles as the PolyServe TIER KEY, so every
class states it explicitly. Values are EXP-17/21's, unchanged.
